command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -I scripts/exp_rhc_balancing.py --threads 4 --alpha certified --threshold plugin --outdir results/v2

data.source: Connors et al. (1996), via the Vanderbilt Biostatistics dataset repository (hbiostat.org/data/repo/rhc.csv)
data.excluded: outcome and date fields; adld3p (75% missing); urin1 (53% missing)
data.caveat: wtkilo1 records 515 zero weights, the dataset's known missing-as-zero coding; kept as in the published analyses

smd_definition: realdata_run.standardized_differences: weighted mean difference / sqrt((weighted var_x + weighted var_y)/2); *_fixed_sd columns use the unweighted pooled SD instead
overlap_definition: realdata_run._overlap, 40 bins on [0,1], logistic propensity of realdata_run._logistic_fit
energy_balancing: Huling & Mak (2024), J. Causal Inference 12: per arm, argmin over the simplex of 2 sum_i w_i mean_j|X_i - Z_j| - sum_ik w_i w_k |X_i - X_k| - mean_jl |Z_j - Z_l| (Z pooled); 'improved' adds the energy distance between the two weighted arms and is solved jointly
kernel_balancing: per arm, argmin over the simplex of the squared MMD to the pooled sample, Gaussian kernel at the trimming's bandwidth
solver: FISTA with projection onto the simplex, stopped when the Frank-Wolfe gap <= 1e-09 or after 100000 iterations
